description: Use this when the user wants to split a job into work AI can do now, work AI should draft for approval, and work that needs a person, before hiring. For example "which tasks of a bookkeeper need a person?", "split a software engineer role" or "job ad and two-week trial for a restaurant cook". Pass a job title, or an O*NET-SOC code such as 15-1252.00. Pass a description only when the title is vague, with no names or contact details. Returns the matching O*NET occupation, each task tagged ai_now, ai_draft or human with the rule and reason, a job-ad skeleton for the human tasks, and a two-week trial template. It does not evaluate a person, read a resume, or give hiring, legal or pay advice. If it does not match, it says no_match instead of inventing tasks.

description.description: Optional job description, used only when the title is ambiguous. Not stored. Do not include names, emails or phone numbers.

occupations.description: How many matching occupations to expand, 1 to 3. Default 1. Further matches are listed as codes and titles only.

title.description: A job title, or an O*NET-SOC code such as 15-1252.00. Do not include a person's name, email or phone number.

name: split_role

job_ad.description: Skeleton for the human pile. Empty responsibilities means do not hire for the listed tasks.

match.description: How the occupation was chosen: code, occupation_title, alternate_title, tokens or model.

occupations.description: Matching occupations with each task tagged ai_now, ai_draft or human.

title: Split a role into AI and human work
